name: Report to Sen'jin Village
summary: Zureetha Fargaze sends word from the Valley of Trials to Sen'jin Village. Burning Blade cultists have been active in the valley, and she asks young initiates to warn the Darkspear trolls. Master Gadrin tells them dark magic threatens the nearby Echo Isles.

sections.title: Leaving the Den
sections.body: Young initiates leave the Valley of Trials after proving their combat mettle and recovering dark medallions from the Burning Blade Coven. Zureetha Fargaze sees that the demons in the sacred proving grounds are no isolated nuisance; they point to a blight spreading across Durotar. She sends the proven fighters east past the ravine's mouth, then south toward the coast, to warn the Darkspear tribe.

sections.title: Shadows over the Coast
sections.body: At Sen'jin Village, travelers bring their warning to Master Gadrin, the elder witch doctor guiding the Darkspear in exile. Gadrin says the Burning Blade has not marched on the village sands. Yet dark magic has taken root nearby on the Echo Isles, and betrayal threatens the trolls there. The young Horde's foothold remains fragile as allies hurry to defend one another while tribal divisions and fel corruption strike at their flanks.

faq.q: Why is Zureetha Fargaze sending people away from the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: Demonic activity in the Valley of Trials makes Zureetha Fargaze fear the Burning Blade is an organized threat to all of Durotar. She sends proven initiates beyond the valley to warn allied settlements and learn how far the cult's influence has spread.

Master Gadrin is an elder witch doctor and spiritual leader of the Darkspear trolls in Sen'jin Village. He advises chieftain Vol'jin and oversees tribal matters while facing threats to their coastal refuge.

faq.q: Has the Burning Blade attacked Sen'jin Village?
faq.answer: No, the Burning Blade has not attacked Sen'jin Village. Master Gadrin warns that dark magic and betrayal have taken root nearby on the Echo Isles, putting the trolls in danger.
Sen'jin Village lies east beyond the main canyon exit of the Valley of Trials, then south at the road's fork along Durotar's southeastern coast.

faq.q: What threat does Master Gadrin mention on the Echo Isles?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin fears Zalazane, a fellow troll witch doctor, has betrayed the Darkspear. Zalazane used insidious hexes to enslave his brethren and seize control of the Echo Isles, driving the surviving Darkspear onto the mainland shores.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Master Gadrin?
aliases: next quest after report to senjin
faq.answer: After hearing your report and describing the trolls' plight, Gadrin asks you to help against the dangers threatening the coastline. Further orders then send you northwest to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

angles.text: As a member of Thrall's Horde, you see its founding races share warnings to protect one another's young settlements.
As a Darkspear adventurer, you return to Sen'jin Village to face your people's displacement and their struggle to reclaim the Echo Isles.
As a young orc, you leave the Valley of Trials to aid the Darkspear, an early test of honor and solidarity with the allies who stood beside Thrall across the Great Sea.
